name: quorum
description: Two agent patches, one decision: both reviewers choose on the desk, a threshold-2 join hears them together, and the lead's gate drives a real git merge, declared as an effect.

neurons.description: Where the agents' two candidate branches are put to the team, as one ask with options.
A reviewer's choice: which patch should land.
The other reviewer's choice, on its own desk item.
The quorum: acts only when both reviewers have chosen, then asks the lead - one Merge on agreement, both options on a split.
The lead's gate: merge the branch, or No.
Runs git merge --no-ff on the chosen branch in the scratch repo. An effect: never cut, and a crash is unknown, not an error.
